\[
\hat{x} = \text{up}\big(f_\theta(\text{down}(y),\ M_\sigma)\big)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The noisy image
- \(M_\sigma\): The noise level map
- \(f_\theta\): The network

down splits the image into four subimages of half the width and height, and up joins them again. M is a map filled with the noise level, given to the network as an extra channel. 12 convolutions with ReLU map the subimages and the noise map to the clean subimages.
